appDescription.message: Translate manga and comic pages in place on any site, using your own Claude API key. No account, no server.

cmdTranslate.message: Translate all images currently on screen

cmdToggle.message: Show / hide translations on this page

popup_turn_gytakusub_on_or_off.message: Turn Gytakusub on or off on every site

popup_finish_setting_up_gytakusub_see.message: Finish setting up Gytakusub. See what it sends to Claude, agree, and allow it to read manga images. It takes a minute.

popup_offNote.message: Gytakusub is off on every site. Turn it on with the switch above; your settings are kept.

popup_allow_gytakusub_to_read_manga.message: Allow Gytakusub to read manga images on websites.

popup_sends_pages_to_claude_as.message: Sends pages to Claude as you scroll

popup_usageToday_title.message: What translating cost today, counted in this browser (details in Settings)

popup_exportReport_title.message: One .zip with every translated page on this tab: original image, debug render and JSON

popup_no_access.message: Not allowed, so Gytakusub can't read the images here. Choose Allow access when you're ready.

popup_not_active.message: Not active on this page yet. Translate still works.

popup_reload_tab.message: Reload the tab to activate Gytakusub here.

popup_allow_above.message: Allow access (above) to use Gytakusub here.

popup_usage_today_aria.message: What translating cost today: about {cost}. Open details.

welcome_allSet.message: You're all set. Open a manga chapter and click the Gytakusub icon in the toolbar.

welcome_only_the_pages_you_translate.message: Only the pages you translate. A page is read when you click its Translate button, press Alt+T, or turn on auto-translate for that site. Other pages are never read.

welcome_sent_to_anthropic_s_claude.message: Sent to Anthropic's Claude API, with your key: the page image (cut into slices), your glossary and custom instructions, and the names already translated in the same chapter. With Chapter context (on unless you turn it off), also the last lines of dialogue.

welcome_nowhere_else_gytakusub_has_no.message: Nowhere else. Gytakusub has no server, no account and no analytics. Your key stays in this browser. Your settings and glossary go with your browser's own sync, if you use it (the key too, only if you choose that in Settings).

welcome_anthropic_handles_what_you_send.message: Anthropic handles what you send under its commercial terms and privacy policy. Gytakusub's privacy policy has the details.

welcome_create_a_key_in_the.message: Create a key in the Claude Console (API keys), then paste it in Gytakusub's settings. The key stays in this browser and is only ever sent to Anthropic.

welcome_manga_sites_usually_load_their.message: Manga sites usually load their pages from other image servers, so Gytakusub asks for access to all websites. Your browser will ask you to confirm with its standard wording, "Read and change all your data on all websites". Gytakusub uses it only to download the images you translate: it reads a page only when you translate it, runs by itself only on sites where you turn on auto-translate, and never changes anything on a page except drawing the translation over the image.

welcome_open_a_chapter_on_a.message: Open a chapter on a manga site.

welcome_click_the_gytakusub_icon_in.message: Click the Gytakusub icon in the toolbar. If you don't see it, open the puzzle-piece menu and pin Gytakusub.

welcome_turn_on_enable_here_for.message: Turn on Enable here for a Translate button on each page, or Auto-translate while scrolling. Or just press Alt+T to translate what's on screen.

welcome_you_pay_anthropic_for_what.message: You pay Anthropic for what you use, from your Claude Console balance. The default model, Haiku 5.5, is priced at 1/20 of Sonnet 5.5 (Anthropic's prices). Once you've translated a few pages, Settings → What translating costs shows what they cost you per page, counted from Claude's own answers to this browser.

welcome_to_cap_your_spending_on.message: To cap your spending on every device, set a monthly spend limit on the Console's Billing page (Spend limits). Claude stops there.

welcome_found_a_problem_or_have.message: Found a problem or have an idea? Open an issue on GitHub. Issues are public, so don't attach manga pages or debug reports there.

welcome_gytakusub_is_an_independent_open.message:
Gytakusub is an independent, open-source project. It is not made by, endorsed by or affiliated with Anthropic.
Source code · Privacy policy

welcome_lede.message: Gytakusub translates manga, manhwa and comics on the websites you choose, with your own Claude API key. Three steps and you're ready.

welcome_lede_update.message: Gytakusub now asks before it reads any page. Please look at what is sent and agree, to keep translating.

welcome_hint_agreed.message: You agreed on {date}. You can withdraw any time in Settings → About.

welcome_hint_not_agreed.message: Nothing is sent until you agree. You can withdraw any time in Settings → About.

welcome_hint_access_remove.message: You can remove this any time in Settings → About, or on the browser's extensions page.

welcome_not_allowed.message: Not allowed. Gytakusub can't read manga images until you allow it.

welcome_language_hint.message: Gytakusub's own pages follow this language too, where they're translated. More languages: Settings → Translation.

opt_gytakusub_sends_pages_to_claude.message: Gytakusub sends pages to Claude with your own key.

opt_apiKeyHint.message: Create one at platform.claude.com → Settings → API keys. Usage is billed to that Console account, separately from a Claude subscription (Max, Ultra and Team plans include monthly API credits).

opt_sync_the_key_to_my.message: Sync the key to my other browsers

opt_keeps_it_in_browser_sync.message: Keeps it in browser sync instead of only on this device

opt_claude_sonnet_5_5_better.message: Claude Sonnet 5.5 — better on dense / stylised pages

opt_claude_opus_5_5_best.message: Claude Opus 5.5 — best quality, most expensive

opt_counted_from_claude_s_own.message: Counted from Claude's own answers to this browser. Your phone and other browsers keep their own counts.

opt_cuModels_arialabel.message: This month by model, with the cost per page

opt_cap_your_spending_on_every.message: Cap your spending on every device. Set a monthly spend limit in the Claude Console (Billing → Spend limits). It covers everything that uses your key, and Claude stops there.

opt_estimate_tokens_are_exact_the.message: Estimate: tokens are exact; the cost uses Anthropic's prices (checked ). A page served from the cache costs nothing and isn't counted.

opt_exact_bill_the_claude_console.message: Exact bill: the Claude Console's Usage and Cost pages.

opt_balance_and_credits_including_a.message: Balance and credits (including a plan's monthly API credit): the Console's Billing page. Anthropic has no way for apps to read them.

opt_days_start_at_midnight_utc.message: Days start at midnight UTC your time (midnight UTC), like Anthropic's usage reports.

opt_glossary_placeholder.message:
One per line, e.g.
Gojo Satoru = Satoru Gojo
呪術 = jujutsu

opt_glossaryHint.message: Names and terms the model must use exactly. Names it discovers on its own are remembered per tab automatically.

opt_sends_names_and_the_last.message: Sends names and the last ~40 translated lines of this tab with each page: better continuity, about 400 extra input tokens

opt_slower_slightly_more_careful_reading.message: Slower, slightly more careful reading; useful for debugging

opt_one_hostname_per_line_the.message: One hostname per line. The easiest way to add a site: open it and use the switches in the toolbar popup.

opt_enabledSitesHint.message: The hover button and keyboard shortcuts work only here. Everywhere else Gytakusub stays dormant until you use the toolbar button or the shortcut.

opt_autoSitesHint.message: Each page that scrolls into view is sent to Claude automatically, so only add sites where you want to spend tokens. These count as enabled too.

opt_excludedSitesHint.message: Gytakusub stays off on these sites and their subdomains.

opt_fontHint.message: Leave empty for the bundled lettering font (Comic Neue Bold), or name any font installed on this device, e.g. "Bangers".

opt_finds_text_and_bubbles_much.message: Finds text and bubbles much faster. Turn off only if pages come out wrong or the browser misbehaves.

opt_peek_at_the_original_while.message: Peek at the original while hovering

opt_hovering_a_translated_bubble_shows.message: Hovering a translated bubble shows the original lettering. To fix a line, double-click its bubble.

opt_draws_the_detected_regions_and.message: Draws the detected regions and text areas on translated pages, and adds a Report button to the hover bar that downloads that page's original, debug render and JSON. "Export debug report" in the popup does every translated page on the tab.

opt_translated_pages_the_names_found.message: Translated pages, the names found per tab and your edited lines are kept until the browser closes. Clear them to translate pages afresh.

opt_report_a_problem_or_ask.message: Report a problem or ask on GitHub Issues. Issues are public, so don't attach manga pages or debug reports there.

opt_gytakusub_is_an_independent_project.message: Gytakusub is an independent project, not made by or affiliated with Anthropic. Privacy policy · Setup guide

opt_gytakusub_is_free_software_under.message: Gytakusub is free software under the GNU AGPL v3 · source code · third-party components

opt_confirm_clear_usage.message: Clear this browser's usage history? The Claude Console keeps its own records.

opt_confirm_clear_cache.message: Clear the translated pages, the names found per tab and your edited lines?

opt_cache_cleared_unsaved.message: Cache cleared. Your other changes are not saved yet.

opt_consent_agreed.message: You agreed on {date}. Withdraw and nothing more is sent until you agree again.

opt_consent_none.message: Not agreed yet, so nothing is sent. Open the setup page to see what is sent and agree.

opt_access_allowed.message: Allowed: Gytakusub can read images on websites, only when you translate or on sites with auto-translate on.

opt_access_none.message: Not allowed: Gytakusub can't read manga images until you allow it.

opt_agree_first.message: Agree to what is sent first

opt_target_language_hint.message: Gytakusub's own pages follow this language too, where they're translated (otherwise English).

content_report_title.message: Download a diagnostic report for this page (original, debug render, JSON)

content_nothing_translated.message: Nothing translated on this page yet

content_report_done_one.message: Report downloaded ({n} page, {size} MB). It contains the page images: share it privately, never in a public issue.

content_report_done_other.message: Report downloaded ({n} pages, {size} MB). It contains the page images: share it privately, never in a public issue.

content_paused_one.message: Auto-translate paused after {n} page in 10 minutes, to keep your Claude spending in check.

content_paused_other.message: Auto-translate paused after {n} pages in 10 minutes, to keep your Claude spending in check.

content_teach.message: Teach the glossary (applies to later pages)

content_fill_both.message: Fill both the original term and its translation

content_off_here.message: Gytakusub is off on this site

bg_no_access.message: Gytakusub needs your permission to read images from {host}. Open the Gytakusub popup and choose Allow access.

bg_download_failed.message: Could not download the image from {host} ({error})

bg_not_image.message: That address did not return an image

bg_not_set_up.message: Gytakusub isn't set up yet: open the Gytakusub popup and choose Set up, to see what is sent to Claude and agree.

bg_no_key.message: No API key set. Open Gytakusub's settings and paste your Claude API key.

bg_gloss_both.message: Both the original and the translation are needed

bg_report_needs_debug.message: Turn on the debug overlay in Settings to export reports

usage_limits.message: Speed limit (a minute's worth, refilling as you go): {parts} left at {time}.

api_err_spend_cap.message: Your Claude account reached its monthly spend cap. The API pauses until 00:00 UTC on the 1st, unless you ask for a higher limit in the Claude Console.

api_err_rate_limit.message: Claude's rate limit for your account was reached for the moment. Wait a minute and translate again; fewer pages at once also helps.

api_err_credit.message: Your Claude credit balance is too low. Add credits (or check your plan's monthly API credits) in the Claude Console under Billing.

api_err_spend_limit.message: Your Claude account reached the spend limit you set. Raise it in the Claude Console under Billing → Spend limits.

api_err_key.message: Claude refused the API key. Check it in Settings, or create a new one in the Claude Console.

api_err_overloaded.message: Claude is overloaded right now. Try again in a minute.

opt_customPrompt_placeholder.message: e.g. Keep the tone casual. Translate SFX as English onomatopoeia.
